items.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
items.summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

items.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
items.summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

items.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

items.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
items.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

items.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
items.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

items.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
items.summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

items.title: Solana drops ‘beta’ label after more than six years
items.summary: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.

items.title: Old crypto feud reignites: Why OKX's Star Xu blames Binance for two years of October crashes
items.summary: CZ says Binance isn’t selling crypto and he has been buying. OKX founder Star Xu accuses him of misleading customers about the exchange’s role in successive October crashes.

items.title: Bitcoin was supposed to gain as AI faltered, but it crashed. Here's why.
items.summary: The price action runs counter to a crypto-market view that a cooling AI trade would trigger a rotation into digital assets and spark a rally.

items.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border payments to reduce settlement risk
items.summary: Zero-knowledge proofs let each ledger verify the other leg was locked, so neither currency settled unless both did, with no shared ledger or intermediary.

items.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
items.summary: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

items.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
items.summary: The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.

items.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
items.summary: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

items.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
items.summary: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.

items.title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
items.summary: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
items.summary: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

items.title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
items.summary: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

items.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
items.summary: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

items.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
items.summary: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

items.title: Alibaba's Qwen 4 Max Leads China's AI Agent Race—But You Can't Download It
items.summary: Alibaba's new flagship jumps ahead of Chinese rivals on agent and web design leaderboards, with cheaper API access. The closed model also previews the next generation of open Qwen releases.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Customer Data Was Exposed Again
items.summary: A second Trezor shipping partner was breached in three months, exposing buyers' addresses and order details.

items.title: Bitcoin's $2 Billion Liquidation Weekend Leaves Traders Watching $60,000
items.summary: Bitcoin fell near $62,100 as forced liquidations swept crypto markets. ETF withdrawals and a crowded options trade offer a closer look at the damage left behind.

items.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
items.summary: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”

items.title: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
items.summary: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

items.title: Clarity Act Defeat ‘Failure of American Leadership’: Trump’s Former Crypto Chief
items.summary: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.

items.title: Trump Backs Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia as Sam Altman Says 'Heroes Have Flaws'
items.summary: Trump would welcome Nvidia’s co-founder back. Altman, who survived his own CEO ouster, sympathizes but stops short of endorsing Huang’s comeback.

items.title: Fed Is Modeling AI 'Super Intelligence' Scenarios, Including Job Losses and a Stock Market Slump
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh says staff are studying three possible economic futures for AI, ranging from widespread productivity gains to higher unemployment and a painful correction in technology stocks.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Has a 20% Rebound in Sight—If Bulls Can Clear a Hurdle
items.summary: Nvidia shares tanked specularly last week amid the Jensen Huang scandal. Is it in for a major rebound? Here’s what the charts suggest.

items.title: Saylor’s Strategy Keeps Buying Bitcoin, Adding 'A Little Orange' Through the Dip
items.summary: The modest purchase lifted Strategy’s stash to 850,849 BTC as chairman Michael Saylor shrugged off a sharp downturn, posting that “this dip could use a little orange.”
